note: Giancoli ch2 sections 2-1..2-7 (Parker's marks stop on printed p.34, early in 2-7; nothing marked in 2-8). 31 marks -> 32 notes. | Parker asked for the constant-acceleration validity card after the hand-off; added as card 32 and the four sibling stems re-cued to remove the front-side leak. | Second pass 2026-08-31: Parker asked whether the cards were really perfect. A cold re-read of all 33 found 7 defects, one of them a flat factual error (card 25). All fixed in the file and on the live notes.

new_hazards_found.summary: lexicon.py --find picked the FIRST definition-shaped sentence in book order, so all four of physics ch2's purple words anchored to unrelated pages (magnitude -> order of magnitude; vectors -> a front-matter colour note; translational motion -> a momentum heading 148 pages away). The gate then pressures the drafter to adopt the wrong anchor.
new_hazards_found.fix: lexicon._pick_nearest() prefers the candidate nearest the marked page; anchors >25 pages away are stamped far_from_mark and printed with a SENSE-CHECK. The CLI builds the page hint from the highlights file.

new_hazards_found.summary: run_store.record()/snapshot() wrote an extensionless file for a bare stem, so anki_write.py --run refused the write with a message about provenance.jsonl not existing — an error describing a different failure entirely.
new_hazards_found.fix: run_store._named() appends the extension only when the name has none, so a bare stem and a full filename land on the same file.

new_hazards_found.summary: build_figure_index's vector-render path produced page-region guesses carrying body-text bleed (FIGURE 2-6/2-11/2-12/2-21) and drifted its labels by one (FIGURE 2-2's file is the pinecone art, not the train). All were caught at the judge-look and rejected; two correct plates were force-added.
new_hazards_found.known: already documented in SKILL.md Stage 2.9 ('for vector-art books ... automated region-guessing produced truncated fragments on Snustad ch9'); this run is a second confirmation, not a new failure mode
new_hazards_found.why: telling a complete plate from a page-region guess is exactly the judgement the mandatory judge-look (Stage 2.95) exists to make; a mechanical proxy would either reject legitimate text tables or pass bleedy renders. The existing guard is the right one and it worked.

new_hazards_found.summary: check_cards.py --live all built its Anki query with the deck root UNQUOTED, so every deck name containing a space matched nothing. The card-rules #32 safety sweep had therefore been reporting 'checked 0 cards / deterministic checks clean' for physics (98), genetics (181) and Arabic (62) — 341 live notes — while only EMT (all::EMT, no space) was ever really swept.
new_hazards_found.fix: check_cards.live_query() always quotes the deck path, for `all` exactly as for `N`. Swept properly afterwards: 0 hard errors across all three sources, 88 warnings left for their own chapters.
